task.agent_directive: Investigate Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue (custom AI accelerators/XPUs and AI networking), recent figures and growth, with cited sources.

tool_arguments.query: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue Q2 fiscal 2025 custom AI accelerators XPUs

events.content: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue Q2 fiscal 2025 custom AI accelerators XPUs

**Broadcom’s Q2 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $10.8 billion**, up **143% year over year**, driven by demand for **custom AI accelerators (XPUs)** and **AI networking**; the fiscal quarter ended **May 3, 2026**. [[1, 2]] 

This result was modestly above Broadcom’s Q1 outlook for **$10.7 billion** in Q2 AI semiconductor revenue, an outperformance of roughly **$0.1 billion (0.9%)**. [[3]] 

For context, Q2 semiconductor-solutions revenue was **$15.009 billion**, meaning AI semiconductors represented about **72.0%** of the segment; total company revenue was **$22.187 billion**, making AI semiconductor revenue approximately **48.7%** of consolidated sales. [[1, 2]] 

Broadcom guided Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue to **$16.0 billion**, implying more than **200% year-over-year growth** and roughly **48% sequential growth** from Q2. [[1]] 

The key takeaway is that Broadcom’s AI revenue category encompasses both the **custom accelerator/XPU silicon** deployed by hyperscalers and the **networking components** required to scale those accelerator clusters; the company did not disclose a Q2 revenue split between the two categories. [[1]]

tool_arguments.query: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 AI custom accelerator XPU revenue breakdown split custom AI accelerators networking

events.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 AI custom accelerator XPU revenue breakdown split custom AI accelerators networking

In Broadcom’s fiscal Q3 2026 (ended August 2, 2026), custom AI accelerators/XPUs accounted for **73%** of the company’s **$16.7 billion** AI-semiconductor revenue, or approximately **$12.2 billion**. [[1, 2]] 

AI networking was the remaining **27%**, or approximately **$4.5 billion** of Q3 AI-semiconductor revenue. [[3, 2]] 

Thus, the XPU-to-networking revenue mix was roughly **73% / 27%**—about **2.7×** as much XPU revenue as AI-networking revenue. [[1, 3]]
